author: smcarus
title: Will Zambia's external debt be smaller, against national income, in 2026 than in 2025?
summary: Give the probability that World Bank external debt stocks for Zambia, in % of gross national income, are lower for 2026 than for 2025, both as first read on or after 15 January 2028 (after the World Bank's yearly debt report).
knownLimits: The World Bank may not have published 2026 by the settle date; then the Quest is Unresolvable.
Zambia's debt restructuring and moves in the kwacha change the ratio as much as new borrowing does.
Zambia must be on your watchlist for its latest figure to show on this page; the result is settled from the published series either way.
